main.name: The Silent Bell
main.desc: The Shrine Bell has not rung, and the Lanterns will not light. Granny Sachi has asked Mio to find out why.
stages: Light the Lantern Post in the village square.
Shift to the Far Shore (Q) and look for a fox spirit.
Ask Elder Matsu about the silent Shrine Bell.
Find a way into Ashiro Well. A boulder blocks the path — try the Far Shore.
Find the Shrine Key in the Well.
Climb to the Bell Shrine and open the gate.
Face the Bell-Keeper at the top of the Shrine.
main.doneText: The Bell-Keeper has been laid to rest. The Far Shore is open.

hanzo.name: A Message for Hanzo
hanzo.desc: A ghost on the Far Shore wants Hanzo, the fisherman, to hear something.
stages: Speak to Hanzo in the Near village and tell him about the ghost.
Return to the Far Shore ghost with Hanzo’s answer.

chime.name: Kiku’s Wind-chime
chime.desc: Little Kiku lost her wind-chime. Something about it shines on the Far Shore.
stages: Search for the wind-chime — maybe it fell somewhere only the Far Shore can see.
Bring the wind-chime back to Kiku.

wisps.name: Wisp Bounty
wisps.desc: Elder Matsu posted a notice: the Dust Wisps are drifting into the fields. Calm or clear 4 of them.
stages: Calm or clear 4 Dust Wisps in the north fields, on the Far Shore (Shift with Q).

sq03.name: Hollow Roll Call
sq03.desc: Sister Ume shows the register: five names are smudged out. She remembers each person only by their trade ('a lamp-oil seller', 'a boy who rang the bell wrong').
stages: Sister Ume shows the register: five names are smudged out. She remembers each person only by their trade ('a lamp-oil seller', 'a boy who rang the bell wrong').
Five Hollow Villagers wander the shrine floors. Each is a different person. Using Remember on one makes it recite a single clue in battle ('smells of lamp oil').
sq03.doneText: The sixth blank is not a villager but a dedication 'to the fox who sat at the shrine gate'. Kaze goes quiet. Players will not understand until Ch6.

sq04.name: The Wrong Note
sq04.desc: Bell Mouse says the shrine bells ring wrong every night. There are three bells on different floors.
stages: Bell Mouse says the shrine bells ring wrong every night. There are three bells on different floors.
Stand at each bell, Shift, and listen: each bell's pitch is different in the two realms (the Far pitch is the 'true' one the dead remember). Note the order from low to high.
sq04.doneText: The 'wrong' notes are the Near bells; the Far bells are right. The puzzle makes Shift a listening tool, using audio as information.

sq05.name: Oto Waits at the Door
sq05.desc: Hisa says a stray dog sits outside her door every night and is gone by morning; she has never been able to pet him.
stages: Hisa says a stray dog sits outside her door every night and is gone by morning; she has never been able to pet him.
Oto is waiting at the Crossing shop door. He will not cross until she says goodbye.
Mio places a Lantern Anchor on the shop doorstep: the Far Shore image holds for one scene so Hisa sees Oto. The Anchor costs Lumen but the quest has a Lantern Post right next to it.
Hisa says goodbye. Oto does not cross; he tells Mio (via bark/ring) that he'll guide others instead.
sq05.doneText: The player expects 'return the lost dog'; instead Oto chooses to stay as a guide because he knows other spirits cannot find the way. The reward is a friend, not a pet.

sq06.name: The Pilgrim Who Never Paid
sq06.desc: Rustle Sprite trades the Remembrance Cord for a Flower Bundle (Marigold Moth Offer or buy in Misty Grove).
stages: Rustle Sprite trades the Remembrance Cord for a Flower Bundle (Marigold Moth Offer or buy in Misty Grove).
Tie the cord to the Pilgrim (Lumen 2). A glowing thread leads to three short Far-only memory vignettes. His name comes back piece by piece.
At the Kappa Toll Gate the Pilgrim presses a coin on Mio (toll_token). The Kappa remembers him: he never paid, but the Kappa never collected either.
Mio chooses: pay the toll (the debt ends, the Kappa forgets him), or leave the debt unpaid (the Kappa keeps the memory but the Pilgrim stays tethered here as a guard).
sq06.reward: Pilgrim Token, Kappa Ointment, Name Fragment ×1
sq06.doneText: The unpaid toll is the Kappa's only memory of the Pilgrim. Paying releases him but erases that memory. The choice is a miniature of the final Remember/Release question.

ch3.name: The Whisper Wick
ch3.desc: Night 3. The Bell rang, then fell silent. The first wick of the Lantern waits somewhere past the Whispering Forest, east of Ashiro.
stages: Take the east road out of Ashiro into the Whispering Forest.
Follow Kaze to the old stump in the forest clearing.
Wake the two Resonance statues together: one sings on each Shore. (Hum, then Anchor.)
Reach the Crossing. The Far Shore bridge drifts; the Anchor Stone may hold it.
Get past the Kappa Toll-Keeper at the ford: pay, Parley or bout.
Find the Willow Mother at the heart of Willow Hollow.
Carry the Whisper Wick back across the forgetting river.
ch3.doneText: The first wick is lit. Its warmth reached all the way back to Ashiro.
